messages:
maria: Quick check — we're finalizing the GA go/no-go gates for Optimize. I want five must-have gates: SLA, Docs, Support, Monitoring, Pricing. Confirm owners and blockers by EOD tomorrow.

ajay: SLA owner here. Draft SLA: 99.9% monthly uptime; p95 latency targets: small models <=150ms, large models <=450ms. Error budget math attached in my note.

kevin: Infra ack. Two must-haves before GA: (1) automated canary fallback policy codified, (2) SLI exporters + trace sampling live. Also want a synthetic long-seq test in CI.

sarah: Docs owner. I'll produce a GA quickstart, migration notes (pinning/compat), streaming & function-calls examples, and a short changelog list of behavior changes. Drafts by Tue COB. Need pricing examples from finops to populate cost tables.

devon: Support lead. I'll own L2 training and the escalation matrix. Runbook template incoming — triage for latency regressions, OOMs, cache degradation. When's the canary schedule?

maria: Canary plan proposed: 48h @1% -> 24h @10% -> 72h @50% -> GA. Health gates: p95, error_rate, model-variant tests. Auto-fallback to a quantized smaller variant on gate failures. Owners, please ensure metrics + alerts are wired before canary start.

ajay: SLA summary to include in acceptance artifact:
- SLA: 99.9% monthly uptime
- SLOs: p95 <=150ms (small), <=450ms (large)
- Error budget: ~43.2 minutes/month
- Compensation: credits for sustained outage >72h
- Canary: staged ramp with health gates

kevin: Monitoring checklist (short): dashboards for token-cost/route, p50/p95/p99, error_rate, queue_length, kv_cache_hit; alerts: error_rate >1% for 5m, p95 breach sustained 5m, queue growth 10m; traces: 1% sample, 10% on errors. I'll add dashboard links to the runbook.

sarah: Docs checklist (short): quickstart (hosted+dedi), migration guide (breaking changes + pin), examples (streaming, function-calls), API limits table, cost calc samples, changelog + deprecation window. Placeholder link: <docs/optimize/ga>.

devon: Runbook items I will add: triage play for p95 regression, escalation path L1->L2->Eng oncall->Product oncall, snapshot collection steps, how to force fallback. PR today.

deploy-bot: Canary job optimize-canary-2026 started (1% traffic). CI logs: https://ci.internal/canary/optimize/174705.

maria: Open risk flags before canary ramp: (A) pricing table for reserved/commit tiers incomplete, (B) billing metric exposure in console missing. @finops-bot can you advise?

finops-bot: Noted. Pricing draft due Wed EOD. Need usage buckets and commit discounts to populate examples. Will coordinate with product.

ajay: Also flagging a flaky model-variant compat test (1/50 failures on long sequences). If unfixed, fallback gate must be stricter.

kevin: Agree. Will add a synthetic long-seq job to gate and block ramp on failures.

sarah: I'll add explicit note in docs about fallback behavior and recommended retry/backoff patterns for SDKs.

devon: Support will run a tabletop exercise Wed 09:30 for escalations. Invite: devon, kevin, sarah, ajay, maria.

maria: Please respond with :white_check_mark: if you accept responsibility and can meet the timelines. I'll collate and publish the GA acceptance artifact once all checks are green. Ping me for blockers.

ajay: :white_check_mark: SLA signoff (pending final flaky-test fix)

kevin: :white_check_mark: Monitoring/infra signoff (adding synthetic test + dashboards)

sarah: :white_check_mark: Docs signoff (initial drafts Tue, final Wed)

devon: :white_check_mark: Support signoff (runbook PR in flight)

maria: Thanks. I'll assemble the acceptance doc and put it up for shiproom review. If pricing or billing metrics block ramp, hold canary and escalate to product leadership.
